# Keys at the edges of the line format, read alike by lib/inventory.js and the CLI:
# an address-only line gives its keys to the named server with that address (either order),
# and a line with keys but no server is noServer only when nothing else was said about it.
10.0.0.81 terminates_tls=no
web21 10.0.0.81
web22 10.0.0.82
10.0.0.82 ports=8443
ports=443
ports=99999
backend=web21 tls_ports=443
